title: Slew Rate
text: Model amplitude, rise and fall times, and propagation delay of logic gates, 1 input, 1 output; {Output step size calculation} Defines how to calculate output step size, {Maximum frequency of interest (Hz)} sets the maximum frequency of interest at output, {Output sample interval}, {Minimum 20%-80% rise/fall time} sets the minimum rise/fall time required at the output for meaningful simulation, {Rise/fall time (s)} sets the 20%-80% rise time, {Slew rate for 20%-80% edge of unit amplitude signal} sets the slew rate for the 20%-80% edge at the output, {Minimum propagation delay}, {Propagation delay (s)} sets the propagation delay of a rising, {Enable increased buffer size} and {Buffer size}. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Output step size calculation
params.values: Defines how to calculate output step size Default (default) | Advanced

params.name: Maximum frequency of interest (Hz)
params.values: Maximum frequency of interest at output 11e9 (default) | scalar

params.name: Minimum 20%-80% rise/fall time
params.values: Minimum rise/fall time required at the output for meaningful simulation 23ps (default) | scalar

params.name: Rise/fall time (s)
params.values: 20%-80% rise time at the output 30e-12 (default) | scalar

params.name: Slew rate for 20%-80% edge of unit amplitude signal
params.values: Slew rate for the 20%-80% edge at the output 56GHz (default) | scalar

params.name: Minimum propagation delay
params.values: Minimum propagation delay for meaningful simulation 48ps (default) | scalar

params.name: Propagation delay (s)
params.values: Propagation delay of a rising edge 48e-12 (default) | scalar

params.values: Buffer size of the blocks 10 (default) | positive integer scaler
